name: Cloudstep Caddie
description: Use an exact pictured hand of roll and chip cards to move a ball across an isometric cloud course and finish in the cup.
natural_language: Read every height step and surface. Spend the exact pictured hand in a legal sequence, then certify the ball in the cup.

metadata.variant_count_kind: seed, palette, board reflection, five controlled difficulty profiles, and two input surfaces
metadata.notes: An original isometric cloud course uses visible z heights, ramps, fairway, sand, water and a cup. Every ordinary-input stroke is replayed independently against the public course and exact hand; failure requests a fresh challenge.
